name: unity-character-creation-plugin
description: 13 workflows for Unity 2.5D pixel RPG characters: master design, eight directions, rig-assisted action baking, pixel cleanup and layered equipment frame playback.

interface.shortDescription: 13 workflows for pixel characters, rig-assisted baking and layered equipment
interface.longDescription: Create a canonical neutral master in simple fitted clothing, author arbitrary actions on a shared Unity 2D rig, bake registered render passes, clean pixel silhouettes, and play synchronized body, hair, clothing, armor and weapon frame banks. Supports eight directions, wardrobe replacement, persistent specifications and visual QA. Requires the separately installed official Unity plugin and connected target Editor on every invocation. Updating the workflows does not automatically convert existing game assets.
